newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA Q1 PROFIT 1.4 MLN LATS.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA Q1 PROFIT 1.4 MLN LATS.

text.p: Latvian leading bank Unibanka on Friday said that its first quarter undivided profit grew to 1.4 million lats.
It did not provide comparative statistics.
Unibanka's own capital increased to 27.4 million lats and assets also showed a positive growth tendency, reaching 153.9 million lats, the bank said in a statement.
The bank said that its total assets were 117.0 million lats.
Unibanka's own capital for the first three months of 1996 was 16.69 million lats.
"The bank continues its tactics of increasing the scope of lending activity," the statement said.
The first quarter of 1997 showed an increase of 28 percent to 61 million lats in the bank's credit portfolio, it added.
Unibanka said that deposits grew during the first quarter of this year by 11 percent to 107.3 million.
"The pace of the bank's development, compared to last year, is favourable," the bank said in a statement.
The bank said that the situation on the financial market has changed drastically compared to last year's first quarter.
"Government T-bill yields are down to between five to 9.5 percent against 40 percent then as the budget was short of funds following a bank crises," it said.
The bank has adjusted its plans for 1997, taking into account the fall in interest rates on loans.
They have fallen gradually during the year to between 15 to 24 percent against 30 percent in 1996, the bank said.
